US Lawmaker Urges Caution on Chinese AI Amid Global Concerns

US Representative Ro Khanna is advocating for a measured approach to Chinese artificial intelligence, seeking to pace its development. This comes as international reports highlight the use of Chinese AI models in sophisticated influence campaigns. The New York Times reported that Iran and China collaborated on novel autonomous AI influence operations, utilizing Chinese open-source AI models and AI agents. The Jerusalem Post noted that a US agency employed a Chinese AI model, even as Washington issues warnings about technological threats from China. These developments underscore global concerns regarding the dual use of advanced AI technologies and their potential for manipulation.
